recognize_zh: 兩顆中等大小的淋巴母細胞，核質比極高、只剩一圈細薄的藍色細胞質，染色質細緻且上方細胞核有凹陷（nuclear indentation），缺乏顆粒與 Auer 小體，符合 T 淋巴母細胞白血病。
features: Two medium-sized blasts, roughly 1.5-2 times the diameter of adjacent red cells
Very high N:C ratio with a scant rim of basophilic, agranular cytoplasm
Round to slightly convoluted nuclei; the upper cell shows a nuclear notch/indentation
Finely dispersed to slightly condensed chromatin with inconspicuous nucleoli
No cytoplasmic granules or Auer rods
Background red cells without specific abnormality; no platelets in this field
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows two medium-sized blasts adjacent to each other. The cells have a very high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratio with a thin rim of agranular basophilic cytoplasm, round to indented nuclei, finely dispersed chromatin and inconspicuous nucleoli. No Auer rods or cytoplasmic granules are identified. The morphology is that of lymphoblasts; lineage assignment requires flow cytometry (cytoplasmic CD3, TdT). Findings are consistent with the stated diagnosis of T-lymphoblastic leukemia/lymphoma.

ddx.vs: Morphologically indistinguishable; B-ALL expresses CD19/CD79a/PAX5 whereas T-ALL expresses cytoplasmic CD3 on flow cytometry.

ddx.dx: Acute myeloid leukemia with minimal differentiation
ddx.vs: Myeloblasts may have similar agranular cytoplasm, but they are MPO/CD13/CD33/CD117 positive and lack cytoplasmic CD3 and TdT-lymphoid profile.
Mature T-cell leukemias show more condensed chromatin (cerebriform or with a single prominent nucleolus) and are TdT and CD34 negative.

ddx.dx: Reactive large granular or atypical lymphocytes
ddx.vs: Reactive lymphocytes have more abundant cytoplasm and coarse mature chromatin rather than fine blastic chromatin.
